clusters.title: Add tests for the new ping helper behavior

member_findings.title: Add tests for the new ping helper behavior
member_findings.impact: The new ping_worker helper ships with input validation and subprocess return-code behavior, but the PR adds no tests. Regressions in empty-host rejection, dash-prefixed host rejection, invalid count handling, or True/False mapping from ping exit status would not be caught by the repository test suite.
member_findings.fix: Add a focused Python unit test for cli.net_check.ping_worker that mocks subprocess.run and covers successful ping, failed ping, empty host, dash-prefixed host, and count < 1.
